goals.label: Three commits in total (skeleton plus your two)

diagnostics.say: Something is staged. If it is the first hunk only, commit it as "fix line two"; then stage the rest for "fix line eleven".

hints: Run git add -p. Git offers the first hunk: answer y.
It then offers the second hunk: answer n. Commit what you staged as "fix line two".
Finish with git add app.txt and git commit -m "fix line eleven".
